name: spotify
description: Icon-only Spotify controls above the prompt (prev/play-pause/next/mute, AppleScript, no login) with a fullscreen sidebar for browsing/playing your playlists and Liked Songs (Spotify Web API, needs your own free Spotify app's Client ID: /spotify config <id>).

clientId.title: Spotify Client ID (optional)
clientId.description: Your Spotify app's Client ID (developer.spotify.com/dashboard, Redirect URI exactly http://127.0.0.1:8907/callback). Easier: run /spotify config <client-id> instead. When set here, this wins over that.
